name: XHS Lulu Girl Vision-First Complete Workflow
description: Complete YOLO+LLM+Chrome Extension workflow to search 'lulu girl' and extract third post creator info

screenshot_and_detect.description: Take screenshot and use YOLO to detect UI elements

args.intent: Take a screenshot of the xiaohongshu.com page and detect all clickable UI elements using YOLO vision model

actions.description: Capture screen and run YOLO object detection

find_search_input.description: Use YOLO+LLM to identify and click search input

args.intent: Find and click the search input box on xiaohongshu.com page. Look for text input, search box, or any input field where I can type search terms.
args.llm_hint: Look for input elements with placeholder text like '搜索', '登录探索', or any search-related text. The search box is usually at the top of the page.

actions.description: LLM identifies search input from YOLO detections and clicks it

type_search_term.description: Type 'lulu girl' in the search input

args.intent: Type 'lulu girl' in the currently focused search input and press Enter to search

actions.description: Type search term using Chrome extension

wait_for_results.description: Wait for search results to load and detect them with YOLO

actions.description: Wait for search results page to load

args.intent: Take a screenshot of the search results page and identify all post/content items using YOLO vision model

actions.description: Detect search result posts with YOLO

identify_third_post.description: Use LLM to identify the third post from YOLO detections

args.intent: From the YOLO-detected posts on the search results page, identify and click the THIRD post/content item. Count from top to bottom, left to right to find the third item.
args.llm_hint: Look for post cards, content items, or clickable elements that represent individual posts. The third one should be clicked.

actions.description: LLM identifies and clicks third post

extract_creator_info.description: Extract creator information from the post page

args.intent: Extract the creator/author information from this xiaohongshu post page. Find the creator's name and profile URL.

extract_data.profile_url: Find link to creator's profile page
extract_data.post_title: Find the post title or content preview

actions.description: Extract creator data using LLM vision analysis
Save creator info to text file
Verify all artifacts were created successfully
Log successful completion with detailed stats

objectives: Demonstrate YOLO object detection on web page
Show LLM decision-making from visual input
